title: The Riemann $Ξ$-function from primitive Markovian cycles II: Strip rigidity and divisor identification
summary: We compare the Riemann $Ξ$--function to a canonical real-entire reference family arising from the cycle Laplacian developed in Paper I. These spectral determinants have only real zeros by self-adjointness. Our main tool is a rigidity lemma for holomorphic functions on horizontal strips. Applied to a normalized seam ratio linking $Ξ(2\cdot)$ to the reference family, this lemma shows that, under explicit holomorphy and boundary nonvanishing hypotheses verified in the forthcoming Paper III, the seam ratio extends to a zero-free holomorphic function of bounded type on each overlap strip.
